enrichment.headline: Cuts $1.42M from Syserco's CAL Shape contract for plumbing fixtures the district supplied
enrichment.summary: Change Order No. 3 is a credit that lowers the price of the CAL Shape design-build project with Syserco Energy Solutions, Inc. The district's Buildings & Grounds Department provided the plumbing fixtures at McClymonds High School, Roosevelt Middle School, Ralph Bunche High School and the Gateway to Laney College Campus. The contract price drops from $11,089,372.83 to $9,669,824.11, as identified in preliminary change order No. 9.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Gives Data Media Services 62 more days to finish Prescott Elementary security upgrades
enrichment.summary: This change order extends the contractor's deadline for the Prescott Elementary School Security Improvement Project from December 28, 2025 to February 28, 2026, an added 62 calendar days. The text says the delay came from administrative coordination and the contractor's late start in bringing in staff, who were committed to other District projects. No money is added, and all other terms of the agreement stay the same.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
